description: Defined terms come before the parties are named.
title: SERVICES AGREEMENT
pages:
SERVICES AGREEMENT
1. Definitions. In this Agreement: "Client" means the customer named in the parties clause; "Provider" means the supplier named in the parties clause; "Services" means the website maintenance described in clause 3; "Hourly Rate" means $75 per hour.
2. Parties. This Agreement is made on August 12, 2026 between Westbrook Example LLC (the Provider) and Ivy Sample Ltd (the Client).
3. Services. The Provider shall maintain the Client's website.
4. Fees. The Client shall pay the Hourly Rate for time worked.
Client signature: ____________________

traps.note: a definition is not a party name
